build.buildCommand: composer install --no-dev --optimize-autoloader && npm install && npm run build

deploy.startCommand: mkdir -p storage/framework/sessions storage/framework/cache storage/framework/views storage/logs && touch storage/logs/scheduler.log && chmod -R 775 storage && export SESSION_DRIVER=cookie SESSION_SECURE_COOKIE=true ASSET_URL=https://godong-ijo-laravel-production.up.railway.app && php artisan schedule:work --no-interaction > storage/logs/scheduler.log 2>&1 & exec php -S 0.0.0.0:$PORT -t public
